categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Suochen Information Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, sales, and services of CAE (Computer Aided Engineering) software. Its primary products include engineering simulation software covering fluid dynamics, structural analysis, electromagnetics, acoustics, optics, and measurement and control, as well as customized simulation product development services. The company also engages in simulation cloud platforms, high-performance computing, and digital twin technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops core algorithms in multiple disciplines such as fluid dynamics (using gas kinetic schemes, DSMC, SPH), structural simulation (meshless particle methods), electromagnetics, acoustics, optics, and multi-physics coupled simulation. It emphasizes high-performance computing with CPU, GPU, and domestic parallel computing platforms. The firm integrates AI, especially generative AI and physical AI, into simulation for digital twin, optimization, and intelligent decision-making. It also employs unified data structures for seamless data flow across simulation stages.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in defense, aerospace, shipbuilding, new energy, and advanced manufacturing sectors requiring high-end industrial software for product design and optimization. The company serves research institutes, military-industrial clients, and enterprises focused on intelligent manufacturing and digital transformation. Its products support complex engineering simulations and digital twin applications in these industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and registered offices in Shanghai. It has subsidiaries and investments in other Chinese cities such as Guangzhou, Beijing, and Zhejiang, and overseas entities in the US, Hong Kong, and the UK. The overseas subsidiaries focus on technology development and software sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suochen Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the industrial software supply chain, focusing on the development and provision of core CAE software tools and simulation platforms. It supports downstream manufacturing and engineering design processes by enabling product simulation, optimization, and digital twin capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, dedicating over 28% of revenue to research and development. Strategic focus areas include advancing core CAE algorithms, integrating AI and physical AI technologies, expanding multi-physics and multi-disciplinary simulation capabilities, and developing cloud-based simulation platforms. It pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance product offerings and ecosystem integration, and emphasizes talent development and retention to sustain innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of proprietary engineering simulation software and customized simulation product development services. Additional income streams include technical services, cloud platform subscriptions, and hardware-related sales such as servers and workstations. The company does not use intermediaries and maintains direct customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes against dominant foreign CAE software providers such as Ansys, Dassault Systèmes, Siemens, and MSC, which hold the majority of the domestic market. Suochen positions itself as a leading domestic CAE software provider with a focus on core technology independence, serving strategic industries with high security and localization requirements. It aims to break foreign monopolies and expand its market share through innovation and strategic acquisitions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 378.8 million, an 18.24% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 41.4 million, a decline of 27.89% due to increased R&D and operational expenses. The company has total assets around RMB 3.07 billion and net assets of RMB 2.85 billion. It maintains a high R&D intensity and is in a growth phase with expanding business scale and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suochen emphasizes its fully independent core technology and algorithms, enabling high-performance, multi-disciplinary engineering simulation software tailored to complex industrial applications. Its unified data structure and integration of physical AI and generative AI technologies provide enhanced simulation accuracy, efficiency, and intelligent decision-making capabilities. The company offers comprehensive solutions covering the entire product lifecycle, supporting domestic industrial software autonomy and security, which differentiates it from foreign competitors.
